events.title: Apple introduces the iPod
events.description: A pocket-sized digital music player becomes a new product for the computer maker.

events.title: Hurricane Katrina strikes
events.description: The hurricane devastates Gulf Coast communities and creates an enormous need for rescue and recovery.

what_happened_next.text:
Apple grew to nearly ten times its starting value, and Boeing more than doubled. The international basket also more than doubled, while Microsoft gained much less. You started after the September attacks, so earlier losses were already reflected in starting prices. These gains do not make a frightening event an automatic buying signal.

In November 2001, Microsoft and the US government proposed a settlement of their competition case. The legal story had moved forward, though review was still required.

Apple introduced the iPod in October 2001, expanding beyond computers into portable music. The business itself was changing while investors held its shares.

Later in the window, euro notes and coins entered everyday use. The Columbia shuttle was lost in 2003. Hurricane Katrina struck the Gulf Coast in 2005, creating enormous needs for rescue and recovery. These events changed people’s lives while businesses and markets continued to respond to many different pressures.

The gain in Boeing is a useful contrast with its planned job cuts at the start. Bad business news does not give a precise five-year stock forecast, just as a product launch does not promise a gain. Your purchase price already reflected the information available that month. The difficult part was deciding what might happen next, without the benefit of the completed chart.

reflection.what_people_were_focused_on: People were mourning, helping one another and reviewing safety. Airlines and aircraft makers were adjusting plans amid uncertainty.
reflection.what_actually_mattered: The period after the investment began determined the result. Different companies recovered differently, and the broad baskets did not depend on one product or industry.
reflection.what_faded_away: An announced job cut did not reveal a company’s five-year stock return. A coming software launch did not either.
reflection.what_nobody_knew: Nobody had a map of the recovery or the future leaders. Seeing Apple’s eventual gain now can hide how uncertain its prospects were then.
